segments.text: WE whose Names are subscribed, having seen the Testimony of our Worthy Brother, Mr. William Lorimer, after his Perusal of this Book, doubt not but it may be of use to many, as the former Writings of Mr. Thomas Watson have been; and with that Desire and Hope, we Recommend it to Masters of Families, and others.

William Bates,
Matth. Barker,
Iohn Howe,
Matth. Mead,
Edw. Lawrance,
Samuel Slater,
Richard Mayo,
